message:
Thanks, Styles. I'm likely being dense, but your hints are somewhat too oblique for me, I'm afraid -- though the style quiz to which you link has interesting class connotations. The Happy Tutor, of course, understands that in many ways, the style *is* the man -- and the project he and others are engaged in at Wealth Bondage has recently taken [a fascinating turn](http://www.thehappytutor.com/archives/2005/05/grab_a_costume.html) in privileging style itself over the identity attached to a name.

Interesting Ruskin reference, though.
![The King of the Golden River](/weblog/assets/goldenriver.jpg)
This little book belonged to Elinor Klink, my great-great-grandmother, in 1909.
